releaseNotes: Version 4.6 (Release v24): Cellular Telephony Ingestion & Hybrid Scripting Engine. Features HardenedTelephonyObserverService with dual reactive SMS/MMS content observers, multi-part segment reassembly with 1200ms debounce, HardenedMmsParser with 3-stage backoff and PduHeaders.FROM resolution, onResume missed-message delta reconciliation, sub-50ms sandboxed JS/arithmetic execution (SimpleMathParser & JavaScriptSandbox), and native SDUI selection components.
